name: Locker Wars asset pack
units: Metres, glTF Y-up. Lots and the locker use locker-local coordinates: door plane at z=0, unit extends along -z.
model_format: Every model is a .json file {"b64": "..."} holding a meshopt-compressed GLB (textures 512 px). Decode the base64 to bytes, make a Blob URL, and load it with three.js GLTFLoader plus MeshoptDecoder (three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js).
values: Item values are game dollars (min/max appraisal range).

characters.name: Auctioneer
characters.description: Runs every sale. Loud, quick, folksy showman.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Alright folks, gather 'round! Unit two-fourteen — let's cut that lock and see what we got!
Okay people, next up: unit three-seventy-seven! Somebody hand me those bolt cutters!
Here we go, folks! Pop that lock!
Take a good look, folks — no touching, no stepping inside!
Five minutes to look... well, five seconds. Make 'em count!
Who'll start me off? Come on, don't be shy!
Let's get this party started — who's opening the bidding?
I got a bid! Do I hear more?
Hup! There it is! Who'll go higher?
Yep! New bid on the floor!
New face, big wallet — I like it!
Come on folks, this is a steal! I'll drop it.
Nobody? Really? Somebody's walking away from a fortune here!
I got a hundred, now one-ten, one-ten, who'll gimme one-ten? One-ten! Now one-twenty, one-twenty... going once... going twice... SOLD!
Let's see what's hiding in there!
That's it for this one, folks — on to the next unit!

characters.name: Big Dave
characters.description: Loud, beefy bulldozer of a bidder.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Outta my way, rookie! Big Dave's buyin' today!
Nah, I'm out. Too rich for me.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Let's keep this professional, shall we?
I've seen better units in my sleep.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: That, my friends, is a genuine antique. I'd stake my tenure on it.

characters.name: Kenny Ka-Ching
characters.description: Hyper young flipper with a catchphrase.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Kenny Ka-Ching, baby! Remember the name!
KA-CHIIING! That's what I'm talkin' about!
Yo, did you see that? Did you SEE that?

characters.name: Auntie Lou
characters.description: Sweet but sharp elderly bargain hunter.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Don't you sass me, young man. I was buying units before you were born.
In my day, this would've cost a nickel.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: I never lose, pal. I just win later.
Keep it, pal. I've got bigger deals waiting.
Heh. Nobody saw that coming... except me.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.description: Bubbly half of a married duo; talks for Ray.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

lines.text: Ray, honey, back the truck up — we've got a good feeling about this one!
Ray says no. Ray always says no.
Ooh, would you look at that!

characters.name: Ray
characters.description: Rosa's husband; says as little as possible.

voice.name: Seedance voice
voice.note: Cloned from two 5-second Seedance clips of the character speaking in character.

cover_fits._about: For each item, the containers that can hide it and how to place them. Put the container at the item's position with the lot yaw, scale it by `scale` [x, y, z] (glTF axes, the container's own w/h/d), rotate the item by an extra `item_yaw` degrees inside it, and raise the item by `item_offset_y` metres. Every pairing was ray-tested: no part of the item is visible from above or the sides. Drapes (tarp, blanket) are open at the floor.
